triggers.name: new_file
triggers.title: New file in folder
triggers.help: Triggers when a file is created or updated in specified directory. Watches first-level directory only. Use the Download file</b action to fetch contents of file. This action requires a connection using OPA version 26.0 or newer.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: path
input.label: Folder
input.hint: Monitor this folder for new files.

input.name: start_time
input.label: Start time
input.hint: Set date and time for monitoring for new files or leave blank to start immediately. Once recipe has been run or tested, value cannot be changed.

output.name: path
output.label: File path (processed)
output.hint: File path after file has been processed.

output.name: name
output.label: File name (processed)
output.hint: File name after file has been processed.

output.name: size
output.label: File size (bytes)
output.hint: File size in bytes

output.name: attr
output.label: Attributes
output.hint: Attributes of the file

output.name: create_time
output.label: Creation time
output.hint: Time when the file was created

output.name: change_time
output.label: Change time
output.hint: Time when the file was last changed

output.name: access_time
output.label: Access time
output.hint: Time when the file was last accessed

actions.name: upload_file
actions.title: Upload file
actions.description: Upload a file to a folder
actions.help: Upload a new file to a SMB folder. If a file with the same name already exists in the folder, it will be overwritten. This action requires a connection using OPA version 26.0 or newer.“

input.name: path
input.label: Folder
input.hint: Upload the file to this folder.

input.name: content
input.label: File contents
input.hint: Use File contents datapill from another action/trigger or provide text directly. Leave it blank to create an empty file at the target location.

input.name: overwrite
input.label: Overwrite existing file?
input.hint: If Yes , overwrite content of existing file with the same name. If No , create a new file and append an incremental number at the end, e.g. report_1.csv, report_2.csv .

output.name: path
output.label: Path
output.hint: Path of the uploaded file

output.name: name
output.label: File name
output.hint: Name of the uploaded file

output.name: directory
output.label: Directory name
output.hint: Name of the directory containing the uploaded file

output.name: writtenLength
output.label: Written Length
output.hint: Number of bytes written
